newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Fairform debuts at HK$1.32 per share.
newsitem.headline: Fairform debuts at HK$1.32 per share.

text.p: Shares of household and bathroom products maker Fairform Holdings Ltd made their trading debut on Wednesday at HK$1.32 per share compared with an issue price of HK$1.08.
Fairform issued 57 million new shares at HK$1.08 each in an initial public offering in Hong Kong.
The 51.3 million shares offered to the public were 56.8 times subscribed. The 5.7 million shares reserved for employees were fully allotted.
The company designs, develops, manufactures and sells electric personal care and healthcare products, and bathroom accessories. Its products are mainly for export to Europe and the United States.
Fairform also makes and sells metal parts and plastic tooling, and provides casing metallisation services.
